title: Degree estimate for a finite tower over a field
statement: Let $K$ be a field and let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ be finite morphisms [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. For each $y\in Y$, suppose $\dim_{\kappa(y)}\Gamma(X_y,\mathcal O_{X_y})\le n$, with the fibre and its scalar action as in [def-weil-pbc-fibre-degree-bound]. Then $\dim_K\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)\le n\dim_K\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$, where the actions come from $g\circ f$ and $g$.

source.place: Proof of Tag 03J6 (lemma-composition-universally-bounded), algebraic part starting Write X_z = Spec(A), Y_z = Spec(B), and k = kappa(z); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03J6

proof.text: Finite morphisms over Spec K make X and Y affine. Set B=Gamma(Y,O) with the algebra from g and A=Gamma(X,O) with compatible algebras from f and f composed with g. The global section map of f is finite, and B is finite over K. Use isAffine_of_isAffineHom, Scheme.Hom.finite_appTop and finite_sections_top_of_isFinite.

B is Artinian because it is finite-dimensional over K. In particular its maximal spectrum is finite. For each maximal ideal p, the isoSpec isomorphisms and fiberDegree_of_isPullback identify p.fiberDegree A with the fibre degree of f at the corresponding point of Y; fiberDegree_SpecMap gives the ring-to-scheme comparison. Apply hf.
Apply the semilocal fibre generator theorem to obtain a surjective B-linear map B^n to A. Restrict it to a K-linear map using the compatible scalar tower.

LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_surjective bounds dim_K A by dim_K B^n. Module.finrank_pi_fintype computes the latter as n dim_K B. The definitions of finrankGamma give the claimed inequality, including n=0 and empty schemes.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03J6 algebraic estimate, replacing summation over local factors by simultaneous Chinese remainder lifting and Nakayama.
